F_Simple.description: Simple question: subject linked to objects via a predicate.
F_Simple.cypher:
MATCH (s:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[r:RELATES_TO]-(o:Entity)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR $nn1 IN [l IN labels(s) | toUpper(l)])
  AND (size($prop1_list) = 0 OR r.name IN $prop1_list)
  AND (size($target_ids) = 0 OR o.uuid IN $target_ids)
RETURN s.name AS subject_name, r.name AS relationship, o.name AS object_name, [l IN labels(o) WHERE l <> 'Entity'][0] AS object_type, r.fact AS fact, r.valid_at AS valid_at
ORDER BY object_name
LIMIT 50

F_LogUnion.description: Union of two relationship patterns from the same subject.
F_LogUnion.cypher:
MATCH (s:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[r1:RELATES_TO]-(o1:Entity)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR $nn1 IN [l IN labels(s) | toUpper(l)])
  AND (size($prop1_list) = 0 OR r1.name IN $prop1_list)
  AND (size($target_ids) = 0 OR o1.uuid IN $target_ids)
RETURN s.name AS subject_name, r1.name AS relationship, o1.name AS object_name, [l IN labels(o1) WHERE l <> 'Entity'][0] AS object_type, r1.fact AS fact, r1.valid_at AS valid_at
UNION
MATCH (s:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[r2:RELATES_TO]-(o2:Entity)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR $nn1 IN [l IN labels(s) | toUpper(l)])
  AND ($nnp2 IS NULL OR o2.uuid = $nnp2)
  AND $nnp2 IS NOT NULL
RETURN s.name AS subject_name, r2.name AS relationship, o2.name AS object_name, [l IN labels(o2) WHERE l <> 'Entity'][0] AS object_type, r2.fact AS fact, r2.valid_at AS valid_at
ORDER BY object_name
LIMIT 50

F_LogIntersection.description: Objects reachable via two predicates from the same subject.
F_LogIntersection.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r1]->(o:Node)<-[r2]-(t:Node {id: $nnp2})
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r1) = $prop1)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, o.label AS object_name, type(r1) AS rel1, t.label AS anchor_name
LIMIT 50

F_LogDifference.description: Objects linked to subject but not to a second anchor entity.
F_LogDifference.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[]-(exclude:Node {id: $nnp2}) }
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, type(r) AS relationship, o.label AS object_name, o.type AS object_type
LIMIT 50

F_CompMore.description: Compare exposure/path length: first entity has more hops than second.
F_CompMore.cypher:
MATCH (a:Entity {uuid: $nnp1}), (b:Entity {uuid: $nnp2}), (shock:Entity {uuid: $nnp3})
OPTIONAL MATCH pa = shortestPath((a)-[*..12]-(shock))
OPTIONAL MATCH pb = shortestPath((b)-[*..12]-(shock))
RETURN a.name AS entity_a, b.name AS entity_b, shock.name AS shock_name,
  length(pa) AS hops_a, length(pb) AS hops_b,
  CASE WHEN length(pa) > length(pb) THEN a.name ELSE b.name END AS more_exposed,
  [rel IN relationships(pa) | rel.fact] AS facts_a,
  [rel IN relationships(pb) | rel.fact] AS facts_b

F_CompLess.description: Compare exposure/path length: first entity has fewer hops than second.
F_CompLess.cypher:
MATCH (a:Entity {uuid: $nnp1}), (b:Entity {uuid: $nnp2}), (shock:Entity {uuid: $nnp3})
OPTIONAL MATCH pa = shortestPath((a)-[*..12]-(shock))
OPTIONAL MATCH pb = shortestPath((b)-[*..12]-(shock))
RETURN a.name AS entity_a, b.name AS entity_b, shock.name AS shock_name,
  length(pa) AS hops_a, length(pb) AS hops_b,
  CASE WHEN length(pa) < length(pb) THEN a.name ELSE b.name END AS less_exposed,
  [rel IN relationships(pa) | rel.fact] AS facts_a,
  [rel IN relationships(pb) | rel.fact] AS facts_b

F_CompApprox.description: Compare exposure/path length: entities within one hop of each other.
F_CompApprox.cypher:
MATCH (a:Entity {uuid: $nnp1}), (b:Entity {uuid: $nnp2}), (shock:Entity {uuid: $nnp3})
OPTIONAL MATCH pa = shortestPath((a)-[*..12]-(shock))
OPTIONAL MATCH pb = shortestPath((b)-[*..12]-(shock))
WITH a, b, shock, length(pa) AS hops_a, length(pb) AS hops_b, pa, pb
WHERE abs(hops_a - hops_b) <= 1
RETURN a.name AS entity_a, b.name AS entity_b, shock.name AS shock_name, hops_a, hops_b,
  [rel IN relationships(pa) | rel.fact] AS facts_a,
  [rel IN relationships(pb) | rel.fact] AS facts_b

F_CompCountMore.description: Count objects for subject where count exceeds threshold.
F_CompCountMore.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, count(o) AS cnt
WHERE cnt > coalesce($threshold, 0)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, cnt AS object_count

F_CompCountLess.description: Count objects for subject where count is below threshold.
F_CompCountLess.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, count(o) AS cnt
WHERE cnt < coalesce($threshold, 999)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, cnt AS object_count

F_CompCountApprox.description: Count objects for subject near a threshold.
F_CompCountApprox.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, count(o) AS cnt, coalesce($threshold, 1) AS t
WHERE cnt >= t - 1 AND cnt <= t + 1
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, cnt AS object_count, t AS target_count

F_QuantCount.description: Count related objects for a subject entity.
F_QuantCount.cypher:
MATCH (s:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[r:RELATES_TO]-(o:Entity)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR $nn1 IN [l IN labels(s) | toUpper(l)])
  AND ($nn2 IS NULL OR $nn2 IN [l IN labels(o) | toUpper(l)])
  AND (size($prop1_list) = 0 OR r.name IN $prop1_list)
RETURN s.name AS subject_name, count(o) AS object_count, collect(r.fact) AS facts, collect(r.valid_at) AS valid_ats

F_QuantCountAtmost.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, count(o) AS cnt
WHERE cnt <= coalesce($threshold, 5)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, cnt AS object_count

F_QuantCountAtleast.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, count(o) AS cnt
WHERE cnt >= coalesce($threshold, 1)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, cnt AS object_count

F_QuantCountApprox.description: Count objects approximately equal to threshold.
F_QuantCountApprox.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, count(o) AS cnt, coalesce($threshold, 1) AS t
WHERE cnt >= t - 1 AND cnt <= t + 1
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, cnt AS object_count

F_QuantCountEqual.description: Count objects exactly equal to threshold.
F_QuantCountEqual.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR s.type = $nn1)
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, count(o) AS cnt
WHERE cnt = coalesce($threshold, 1)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, cnt AS object_count

F_QuantAtmost.description: Filter numeric edge property with at-most bound.
F_QuantAtmost.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
  AND coalesce(r.share, r.weight, 1.0) <= coalesce($threshold, 1.0)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, o.label AS object_name, coalesce(r.share, r.weight) AS value

F_QuantAtleast.description: Filter numeric edge property with at-least bound.
F_QuantAtleast.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
  AND coalesce(r.share, r.weight, 0.0) >= coalesce($threshold, 0.0)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, o.label AS object_name, coalesce(r.share, r.weight) AS value

F_QuantApprox.description: Filter numeric edge property near threshold.
F_QuantApprox.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
WITH s, o, r, coalesce(r.share, r.weight, 0.5) AS val, coalesce($threshold, 0.5) AS t
WHERE val >= t - 0.1 AND val <= t + 0.1
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, o.label AS object_name, val AS value

F_QuantEqual.description: Filter numeric edge property equal to threshold.
F_QuantEqual.cypher:
MATCH (s:Node {id: $nnp1})-[r]->(o:Node)
WHERE ($prop1 IS NULL OR type(r) = $prop1)
  AND coalesce(r.share, r.weight, 0.0) = coalesce($threshold, 0.0)
RETURN s.label AS subject_name, o.label AS object_name, coalesce(r.share, r.weight) AS value

F_QuantMax.description: Return object with maximum related value for subject.
F_QuantMax.cypher:
MATCH (s:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[r:RELATES_TO]-(o:Entity)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR $nn1 IN [l IN labels(s) | toUpper(l)])
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR r.name = $prop1)
WITH s, o, r, coalesce(r.percentage, r.exposure_percentage, r.exposure_amount, r.ownership_percentage, r.value, r.share, r.weight, 1.0) AS val
ORDER BY val DESC
RETURN s.name AS subject_name, o.name AS object_name, val AS max_value, r.fact AS fact, r.valid_at AS valid_at
LIMIT 1

F_QuantMin.description: Return object with minimum related value for subject.
F_QuantMin.cypher:
MATCH (s:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[r:RELATES_TO]-(o:Entity)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR $nn1 IN [l IN labels(s) | toUpper(l)])
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR r.name = $prop1)
WITH s, o, r, coalesce(r.percentage, r.exposure_percentage, r.exposure_amount, r.ownership_percentage, r.value, r.share, r.weight, 1.0) AS val
ORDER BY val ASC
RETURN s.name AS subject_name, o.name AS object_name, val AS min_value, r.fact AS fact, r.valid_at AS valid_at
LIMIT 1

F_GlobalRank.description: Rank a single named metric across every company (optionally segment-filtered); return the top company.
F_GlobalRank.cypher:
MATCH (s:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[r:RELATES_TO]-(o:Entity)
WHERE ($nn1 IS NULL OR $nn1 IN [l IN labels(s) | toUpper(l)])
  AND ($prop1 IS NULL OR r.name = $prop1)
WITH s, o, r, coalesce(r.percentage, r.exposure_percentage, r.exposure_amount, r.ownership_percentage, r.value, r.share, r.weight, 1.0) AS val
ORDER BY val DESC
RETURN s.name AS subject_name, o.name AS object_name, val AS max_value, r.fact AS fact, r.valid_at AS valid_at
LIMIT 1

F_GroupAggregate.description: Average a named metric across companies grouped by BankingSegment; rank segments or compare two named segments.
F_GroupAggregate.cypher:
MATCH (s:Company)-[:RELATES_TO]-(seg:BankingSegment)
MATCH (s)-[r:RELATES_TO]-(o:Entity {uuid: $nnp2})
WHERE r.value IS NOT NULL
WITH seg, avg(r.value) AS avg_value, count(DISTINCT s) AS company_count
ORDER BY avg_value DESC
RETURN seg.name AS subject_name, avg_value AS max_value, company_count
LIMIT 1

F_CompToGroupAverage.description: One company's named metric alongside the average of that same metric across its BankingSegment peers.
F_CompToGroupAverage.cypher:
MATCH (c:Entity {uuid: $nnp1})-[cr:RELATES_TO]-(o:Entity {uuid: $nnp2})
WHERE cr.value IS NOT NULL
RETURN c.name AS subject_name, cr.value AS value, cr.fact AS fact, cr.valid_at AS valid_at
LIMIT 1
